author: @Zarghaam12
text: Interesting discussion! Also to note that Homer borrowed from the East; he was from Anatolia after all. Yes, there were other bards before him, many from Anatolia who passed on their tales to later generation. Odysseus's journey to the underworld is bodily lifted from the Sumerian Epic of Gilgamesh - Utnapishtim, the only mortal granted who was granted immortality by the gods. This is all symbolic - a perilous quest to the edge of the world, usually interpreted as a trip to the land of the dead, i.e. the underworld. Utnapishtim was motivated to take such a perilous journey by his overwhelming grief, and fear too, of death following the passing of his friend Enkidu. Gilgamesh wants to discover the secret of eternal life, hence this trip to the underworld. Odysseus also makes such a journey, meeting dead heroes of the past.

author: @Kevon420
text:
To me the great lesson of Homer that carries onto today in all the arts is one of synthesis. The very greatest artists take the world around them, their inner life, their influences and create something thrilling and striking for their age that is of it and also alters it. You could say this of musicians like Louis Armstrong and Bob Dylan, or filmmakers like Orson Welles and Charlie Chaplin and so on. The Iliad and The Odyssey are grand works of art painted with the pigments of all those who came before Homer, whomever he was his sensibilities as an artist define the work...he was looking at what we think of as a time, a place, a history experientially. 
As Simon reiterated with wonderful constitution the great affect the work we credit to Homer has had on history is not its scientific accuracy to human history, but as a work of art that engaged so many people in so many ways. Homer's works were enjoyed by so many people and all of those people were all out in the world affecting in each of the ways they did for generations. People for ages studied, memorized it and from it built the bedrock of Western canon. How do we explain genius? Why are Jimi Hendrix or Beethoven so great but their relatives or next door neighbors were yet another person who goes about their life unremarkably? It is very romantic, maybe even a bit Homeric to imagine Homer as the great hero of poetry and progenitor of the Western canon alone. If he was one man, or a small set of collaborators, they were flesh and blood like all of us. Alas this being identified as Homer was just tenacious and marvelous enough to give us, somehow, what we now know as The Iliad and The Odyssey. If we cannot give credit flawlessly, let us give thanks generously.

The real city included a much larger fortified lower town, covering around 270,000 m² and supporting roughly 5,000-10,000 people, which is right in line with other important cities of the period. author: @chrisrizos7540
text:
The exchange is stimulating, but I think there is a methodological problem in how the Mycenaean world—and sites such as Mycenae, Tiryns, Pylos, or even Troy—are being conceptualized. It is anachronistic to interpret Late Bronze Age palatial centers through categories derived from much later historical formations, such as medieval urbanism, the modern state, or Roman-style fortified cities. The institutional logic of Mycenaean palatial society was different in kind from the Classical polis, and architectural remains should not be forced into later templates of “city” and “state.”

The Mycenaean palaces are better understood as palatial-administrative and redistributive centers that coordinated production, storage, cult, and elite authority across a surrounding territory. In this respect, they functioned less as “cities” in the later sense and more as nodes within a landscape of settlements, with authority expressed through bureaucratic control, elite networks, and ideologically grounded legitimacy. Analogies with other Late Bronze Age systems (including Near Eastern palace-based polities) can be useful insofar as they highlight forms of rule in which administrative centralization and sacral ideology may substitute, at least in part, for the later urban-fortification model.

Moreover, the relationship between multiple palatial centers should not automatically be read as a single “imperial” hierarchy. The evidence is consistent with regional kingdoms and with a broader shared elite culture, patterns of exchange, rivalry, and alliance-making among peer polities, and varying degrees of hierarchy between central places and subordinate communities. In other words, the palatial world can be described as a networked political ecology rather than a set of autonomous fortified cities.

This matters for interpreting the Late Bronze Age collapse. The archaeological record shows major destructions and burn horizons at several palatial centers within a relatively constrained period, but the pattern is not uniform, and trajectories differ by region. Some sites display discontinuity, others show transformation, and some areas appear to retain or reconstitute settlement and social complexity in new forms. The transition to the later city-state landscape should therefore be treated as uneven, regionally variable, and temporally staggered, rather than as a single synchronized civilizational “break.”

Finally, one should be cautious about inferring political or military capability directly from the scale or defensibility of surviving architectural remains. Monumentality and fortification reflect particular choices within specific institutional contexts; they are not straightforward proxies for mobilization capacity, expeditionary reach, or strategic effectiveness. Historical examples from later periods underline the general point that political-military power can rest on social institutions and mobilization systems rather than on conspicuous urban fabric alone, even if the specific mechanisms differ across epochs.

In sum, the Mycenaean palaces should be analyzed primarily as components of a palatial system—administrative, ideological, and economic—embedded in a wider settlement and territorial framework. Treating them as equivalent to later fortified cities risks conflating fundamentally different political forms and, in turn, misunderstanding both the nature of Mycenaean power and the complexity of its transformation after the Bronze Age.

author: @vasiliscond9433
text:
For odd time sigs, I found it better to break them up into groups of 2 3 and 4... For example, you could/should count 1 2 3 4/1 2 3 or 123/1234, that gives the music/song a more solidified feel.
For example, only tapping your foot on 1 do 1 2 3 1 2 and you can immediately feel a groove as opposed to tapping on 1 and 4 and counting to 5, even though they're the same thing. 7 grouped 3 and then 4 is also very natural, and you can tap your foot ever odd number... counting this way makes it alot easier.

I'm greek and it's how I learned to count in our odd songs (5/7/9's). In slower songs you can count to 5 if you're doing 5's or 9's, but keeping it to 2, 3 and 4 makes it much more digestible.

As an exercise, listen to the 7/8 part in tom sawyer by rush and try counting in in 4 then 3 vs 1-7

author: @rcmwandering8653
text:
I do exactly this.  It's the way my birth family thought and I picked it up by osmosis, more-or-less. A couple of years ago, something I read  or heard in connection with a group therapy series gave me the space to realize, half-a-century later, that this is always an emotional over-reacting and that the reality is never as bad as it feels in the moment.  "It'll be better in the morning." 

It never even occurred to me to put a name to that practice. (Which is weird all on its own, but....) 

Life is a lot better since I learned to recognize when I'm doing it again and let it go.  

Still seems to be a common practice in the world around me, though.  Thanks so much for the name -- just that is going to be a great help recovering from it, and the term will be polished to a fine sheen before I'm through using it... 🥴

text:
Before we dive in, I want to say something important.

This video is all about how Dynasty shaped the fashion of the 1980s — the power shoulders, the unapologetic glamour, the drama, the silhouettes that practically screamed confidence. Dynasty wasn’t just a TV show — it was a fashion phenomenon that redefined what power dressing looked like.

And you were absolutely right to point out that I didn’t mention the designers and costume creators behind those iconic looks. That’s on me — and honestly, they deserve their own spotlight.

So very soon, I’ll be releasing a separate video in English where I’ll talk specifically about the designers and costume designers who shaped the visual identity of the show and, in many ways, the entire decade.

Thank you for keeping the conversation sharp and thoughtful. I love that you notice these details — it makes this space so much more interesting. Stay tuned ❤

author: @MARYREED-nh7gb
text:
I would love to know what happened to all those clothes? If I were an actress on that set, I would have had it in my contract that I get the option to keep my wardrobe after all the taping was completed.
Funny story: I was working as surgical assistant to a female doctor when some Dynasty aired in Nepal. She was a MD, (medical missionary) and I was her go-to person doing many of the pre- and post-surgical reviews on the patients (GYN) as well as first (only) assistant in the OR. So, I go to one family's little home to check on a patient, and they were not there. I was told via hand signs that there were in a small building, so I went there. What did I see? A very small black and white TV with Dynasty playing. This was the village's favorite program, and the ENTIRE village was there. They thought ALL American's lived like that!! Well, I saw my patient. Ask her a few questions to close out her record. I also made sure they knew that I was an American and that what I made in 1 year could not pay for 1 of those outfits.

text:
Dekhiye, aap jo mehsoos kar rahe hain—ki har jagah manipulation, dikhawatipana aur "brainwashing" ho rahi hai—wo aaj ke digital aur influencer culture ka ek dark side zaroori hai. Jab hum Skylord (Abhyuday Mishra) jaise bade creators ki death ya Wizzy jaise streamers ki baat karte hain, toh wahan controversy aur theories bohot jaldi phailti hain.

Yahan kuch points hain jo aapko situation samajhne mein madad karenge:

Aapki Galti Nahi Hai: Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapke device (Redmi Note 9 Pro) ya apps par har jagah wahi content dikh raha hai, toh ye Algorithms ka kaam hai. Aap jo search karte hain ya jo community (Free Fire/BGMI) follow karte hain, wahi "chakachaundh" aur "mohh maaya" aapke screen par baar-baar aati hai.

The "Industry" Reality: Esports aur streaming mein power, position aur influence ke liye kai baar content ko manipulate kiya jata hai taaki audience ka dhyan khincha ja sake. Isse "whitewash" ya "brainwashing" kehna galat nahi hoga kyunki creators aksar wahi dikhate hain jo bikta hai.

Saharanpur aur Local Impact: Social media local boundaries nahi maanta. Jo cheez International ya India level par trend karti hai, wahi aapke district Saharanpur mein bhi logon ke phone tak pahunchti hai.

Mental Peace: Ye "jaal saazi" aur "dikhawatipana" internet ka ek hissa ban chuka hai. Agar aapko lag raha hai ki ye aapko affect kar raha hai, toh thoda digital detox (devices se doori) ya algorithm ko reset karna (history clear karna) sahi rehta hai.

Aapka device sirf ek medium hai, par uspar kya dekhna hai aur kis baat par yakin karna hai, wo control aapke paas hai.

Kya aap kisi specific incident ya video se pareshan hain jo aapke feed mein baar-baar aa raha hai?

author: @madsonit
text:
I respect you took the time to do this but this is a very poor comparison and very unrealistic. 

1. A realistic test would be to push it until it crackles. Not until your cpu is overloaded massively at 127%.
2. Just use something CPU limited not RAM limited. Serum + third party plugins on a track and then duplicate that track as much as you can seeing how much it can do before it becomes unstable. Eventually group every 5 tracks to be more realistic and take into account how grouping would distribute loads across cores.
3. Test single core performance as well by loading one single track only with a heavy plugin like a StandardClip with 64x oversampling and see how many instances of that plugin it can run on a single track. This is important for mastering guys who work on a one track project.

Bottom line I haven’t learned anything from this video other than the new generation is clearly better for on device AI music related stuff.

시원님, 이틀 뒤면 제가 시원님을 좋아한 지 100일이 돼요.🌷처음에는 그냥 노래가 좋아서 듣기 시작했는데, 어느 순간부터는 제 하루에 자연스럽게 스며들어 있었어요. 등교하면서, 공부하다가 잠깐 쉬는 시간에, 괜히 마음이 복잡한 날에… 그렇게 제 일상 속에 조용히 자리 잡은 게 시원님 노래였어요.🎸✨ 이 100일 동안 시원님 노래를 들으면서 참 다양한 감정을 느꼈던 것 같아요. 기분이 좋은 날엔 그 기분이 더 오래 가게 해줬고, 조금 지치거나 속상한 날엔 괜히 위로받는 느낌이 들었어요.🌿 같은 노래를 여러 번 들어도 질리지 않고, 오히려 들을수록 더 좋아지는 게 신기했어요. 그래서 제 하루의 배경음악 같은 존재예요.💭🎶
그리고 항상 댓글에 답해주셔서 정말 감사해요.🫶 많은 사람들 중 한 명일 텐데도, 그 한 명을 소중하게 대해 주시는게 느껴져서 더 오래 응원하고 싶어 졌어요. 댓글 하나에 하루 기분이 좋아지는 사람이 여기 있다는 것도 꼭 알아주셨으면 좋겠어요.☁️ 
그리고 가끔은 “내가 왜 이렇게까지 시원님 노래를 좋아하지?” 하고 스스로 생각해 본 적도 있는데, 결국 답은 항상 같았어요. 그냥, 시원님 노래가 제 마음에 닿았기 때문인 것 같아요. 말로 정확히 설명하기는 어렵지만, 목소리에서 느껴지는 진심이 있어서 더 오래 듣게 되는 것 같아요.🎧
그리고 시간이 지나도 변하지 않는 그 분위기, 그 감성 덕분에 더 믿고 듣게 되는 것 같아요. 유행처럼 스쳐가는 노래가 아니라, 제 기억 속에 오래 남는 노래라서 더 소중해요.🤍 시원님 덕분에 제 하루하루가 조금 더 따뜻해졌어요. 시원님 노래가 누군가의 하루를 바꾸고 있다는 걸, 그리고 그 누군가 중 한 명이 저라는 걸 꼭 기억해 주세요.🎶 제 플레이리스트 1번은 여전히, 그리고 앞으로도 시원님입니다.⭐️💫🎵항상 좋은 목소리로 좋은 노래 들려주셔서 감사합니다.🌙

author: @semfoco100
text:
Pela minha pesquisa, a definição de gank nos games varia demais.

Em um momento, li que era obrigatório estar em vantagem numérica para, de fato, um ataque surpresa ser considerado um gank (o que corrobora com a teoria sobre a origem da palavra). Em outro momento, li que vantagem numérica não era um requisito, apenas o fator surpresa (o que corrobora com a ideia de que: gank, no contexto de lives, ganhou esse nome porque, quando você entrega sua audiência para um criador do nada, você causa um efeito surpresa. Ou seja, o efeito surpresa é o que define gank).

Sobre Albion, eu também li duas versões. Uma afirmava que gankar era o ato de eliminar um jogador para obter o loot, e o cara que focava em kills de maneira surpresa era o player killer. Já a outra afirmava que gankar era a kill em si, enquanto que pegar o loot era algo não relacionado com o termo.

Infelizmente, eu não entendo nada desses jogos para saber se gankar tem significado A ou B. Eu procurei no Google, no Reddit, nas IAs, em grupo de Whats (inclusive, eu causei uma mini guerra entre os loleiros quando perguntei sobre gank para eles kkkkkk), enfim, e cada momento eu encontrava uma resposta diferente.

Então, façam o favor de guerrearem aí nos comentários (respeitando o coleguinha) sobre o que é gank, porque isso dá engajamento e o ADM fica feliz 👍

Muito obrigado pela atenção.

text:
Dekhiye, aap jo mehsoos kar rahe hain—ki har jagah manipulation, dikhawatipana aur "brainwashing" ho rahi hai—wo aaj ke digital aur influencer culture ka ek dark side zaroori hai. Jab hum Skylord (Abhyuday Mishra) jaise bade creators ki death ya Wizzy jaise streamers ki baat karte hain, toh wahan controversy aur theories bohot jaldi phailti hain.

Yahan kuch points hain jo aapko situation samajhne mein madad karenge:

Aapki Galti Nahi Hai: Agar aapko lagta hai ki aapke device (Redmi Note 9 Pro) ya apps par har jagah wahi content dikh raha hai, toh ye Algorithms ka kaam hai. Aap jo search karte hain ya jo community (Free Fire/BGMI) follow karte hain, wahi "chakachaundh" aur "mohh maaya" aapke screen par baar-baar aati hai.

The "Industry" Reality: Esports aur streaming mein power, position aur influence ke liye kai baar content ko manipulate kiya jata hai taaki audience ka dhyan khincha ja sake. Isse "whitewash" ya "brainwashing" kehna galat nahi hoga kyunki creators aksar wahi dikhate hain jo bikta hai.

Saharanpur aur Local Impact: Social media local boundaries nahi maanta. Jo cheez International ya India level par trend karti hai, wahi aapke district Saharanpur mein bhi logon ke phone tak pahunchti hai.

Mental Peace: Ye "jaal saazi" aur "dikhawatipana" internet ka ek hissa ban chuka hai. Agar aapko lag raha hai ki ye aapko affect kar raha hai, toh thoda digital detox (devices se doori) ya algorithm ko reset karna (history clear karna) sahi rehta hai.

Aapka device sirf ek medium hai, par uspar kya dekhna hai aur kis baat par yakin karna hai, wo control aapke paas hai.

Kya aap kisi specific incident ya video se pareshan hain jo aapke feed mein baar-baar aa raha hai?

text:
I think my favorite part about your recent karaoke is having me truly appreciate the potential of your voice. The way you can go so gentle/melancholic to cutieful/adorable and to handsome/deep is insane to me. Your voice is also so emotive when you sing, you really capture the feelings of the songs perfectly and manage to resonate those emotions inside of me. Honestly felt so full yesterday like I ate a full course meal with all the flavors of you 😋🍽️ (which I can eat everyday tbh 🫣🤤)

I really do love your voice and hope you continue to find the confidence and fun of singing live. I think the charm of live singing is appreciating the rawness and imperfections without all the fine tuning. Also just like any skill, it just takes time to hone and master it. So no matter how many times I have to repeat it, I will continue to admire & praise you by letting you know your voice is wonderful, your singing is wonderful, and you are wonderful (and cutieful)!~🫵💖 Please praise yourself, be proud, and be more confident about your live singing as much as I love you or else-💥💚💥💥💥

author: @TheDaftWilliam
text:
So I love unique testing/tracing methods. Very good use of a tone generator!

One time had a customer with a similar issue, we had a cable broken in the floor heating circuit run. Just so happens the shop I worked for also did high voltage and substation work too, and we had an 80kV old school Hi-pot tester. We had some continuity but the resistance was very high. We figured we could weld the wires back together with an 80,000v pulse from the test set, and it worked! Then we used a Variac to send some current through the new connection we burnt, and scanned the floor with a hi-res infrared camera. Immediately isolated the break point and homeowner only had to replace one tile. Love it!

Ah, good old Federal No-Blo breakers.

I was identifying breakers and outlet circuits on one job by putting shorting jumpers in each outlet, then looking for continuity at the panel.  I had forgotten to remove the jumper from one outlet, and turned its breaker on - It just sat there and hummed, but never tripped.

Add to this that the "on" position is toward the outside, so it pulled the stablok connection off the bus every time unless the cover was on.

These things sucked way too long before they were finally pulled by code.

author: @Nazo-kage
text:
I’m sorry, but that final one was pretty insulting.
The entire twist of links awakening is the sheer fact that for link to leave the island and go home would mean that he would have to essentially kill everybody on that island.

It doesn’t matter if in the end it’s shown that it was the right thing to do. It’s still an extremely dark thing.

The whole point of that three second end of the game scene that you get for being able to beat the game without dying.
Is supposed to show that the only one on that island that you could consider to be link‘s friend managed to survive the extinction of the island.


Also, the idea in Pokémon.
 that if you caught all 150, your reward would be another Pokémon?
 or a master ball which you wouldn’t need if you’ve already caught every Pokémon.
I actually feel that would be more insulting.
At least, with the thing you get is basically a certificate that you could use as physical bragging rights for your friends at recess.

Doesn’t mean much now for adults, but for little kids which the game was originally made for that was probably a really big deal.

author: @ZTPhotoBo
text: “Takt Op. Symphony,” a tactical strategy gacha-game with characters based on classical music, had a similar long goodbye, when it was announced it would have to shut down in three months due to new worldwide monetization policies. In the 9ish months it was running, it proved to have so much soul baked into the story and characters, and developed a cult following. When the sad news was announced, the developers offered super-boosts of resources and even new PCs in regular intervals, to allow those who stuck around a chance to experience the rest of the game with less grinding. Thanks to that, I managed to build a team with a variation (pun intended) that took me all the way through up until the last bonus boss I could not beat. Regardless of the circumstances, “Takt Op. Symphony” will hold a special place in my heart as one of my favorite gaming experiences.

text:
In my opinion, saying Shadow is Sonic's #1 rival is kinda not true. Let me explain before I get flamed.

Sonic and Shadow, sure they butt heads at each other, but they have repescts for each other and help each other from time to time. So I consider them more so frienemies or just respected allies more than rivals.

Now I say Metal Sonic is Sonic's best rival because not only does Metal Sonic want to throw hands with Sonic at every chance he has, but he also just never respects him nor like him in anyway. 

Metal is trying to prove that he is the REAL Sonic by defeating the real one, and unlike Shadow, Metal doesn't ever want to side with Sonic. But he did in the IDW comics only because Eggman told him to.

So that's why I say Metal Sonic is Sonic's true rival and not Shadow. Metal Sonic and Sonic just hate each other, which fits more as rivals, while Sonic and Shadow have respect for each other while still kinda being friends.

author: @blueabelwilson
text:
I am only 05:59 into the video, so maybe Max addresses this later on, but there are a few things you should keep mind of while messing around with the camera settings. You can set compositional guides under the tab Viewport display for things like the golden ratio as well as the rule of thirds. Under your Blender Preferences, you can change that overlay from black into something more use able like white. Also when you're selecting your focal length, keep in mind what your sensor size is. By default I believe Blender uses a full frame sensor, at 36 mm. You can try different sensors like a RED camera or even a 6x9 medium format sensor. In the real world, your sensor size is supposed to reflect how much light enters the image and your depth of field. When I work in blender, i try to use what I have learned in photography to mimic its feel. Like, realistically not everyone can afford an f1.2 aperture lens. However, your regular f3.5 lens, when you put it on a medium format camera is going to be a lot more zoomed in and also have a shallower depth of field than what you're used to. 
There are other lessons from photography that you can use too. Like don't be afraid of trying different angles as long as you can think of how you would get there. Like if you want to shoot from above, don't just pretend that its a drone shot, maybe show a surface the camera and the photographer was standing on. 
When you're trying to take a photograph from the ground level, think of how you would approach photographing the subject from the ground level. If you know your height in meters. just deduct 15cm from it to get the ideal height your eye would be looking through the view finder and set that to the Z height of the camera location. Alternatively, set the angle you would rotate your camera to one of the following degrees, 0, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120 - Usually when you're shooting with a camera in real life, these are the tilt angles you would mostly use.

author: @mysticalgirljay
text:
Players had spent nearly a decade hearing about Aqua's struggle, and finally seeing her reunited with Terra and Ventus, and ultimately leaving the Realm of Darkness was a huge moment of closure. Aqua wasn't just a story figure; she became playable during the final sequences, giving fans a chance to experience her combat style again, complete with her signature magic and keyblade abilities. Her arrival carried a lot of symbolic weight, the light of her keyblade literally breaking through darkness, visually showing hope prevailing.
Fans had theorized and hoped for her return for years. KH3 made it feel earned rather than sudden, which was satisfying for long-time followers.

text:
I mean, sure it was definitely impactful for being the first, but MY moment was Roxas's return. Being in love with "Days" (as the DS was my only console just as the GBA was) Roxas's story nobody can argue was THE most emotional of all. Everyone & everything he knew disappeared, even one of his best friends got completely erased from existence. And then, when he finally had enough (and pulled both of the best keyblades ever besides WtD) and tried to do something, he got captured and brainwashed into a false life for 3 days (Matrix style) only to remember all the pain right at the last moments, and have to merge with some other boy at the end? THAT'S tragedy. 😢💯

BUT when he used the power of light to travel many worlds away (something Sora or Mickey can't even do){btw only character seen to ever do the same was Yen Sid} just to scream "HANDS OFF MY FRIENDS" was the most emotional I've been in a long time. Only game to make me cry that much was the ending to Crisis Core. IYKYK 😭😭😭

It's left such an impact, i have the nobody symbol tattooed on my right forearm. Was my 3rd of 5 tats. Rocks this is definitely the best KH character 🫂💜🎮🕹️💯

author: @Mintybird
text: I think that Game Changers can and should be allowed to have a range of effectiveness, and comparing them on a power level standpoint is somewhat pointless for that reason. Cards like Braids and Augustin aren't as powerful as some of the CEDH staple GCs, but the purpose of GCs isn't to restrict them to only CEDH it's to restrict them from the much lower bracket 2. They're too mean for casual tables, and make enough of an impact on the flow of the game to make it unfun to play against for most casual players.

author: @Binko_Bonko
text:
It seems like one big problem with game changer discussions is that nobody is very aligned on what the point of the distinction actually is. There are people on one side saying that Grand Arbiter Augustin should be a GC because it's awful to play against in bracket 2, and others saying that cards should be a GC specifically because they're a piece of a cEDH combo, but in bracket 2 they aren't as crazy.

We should be approaching this as "should the card be banned in bracket 2 and limited in bracket 3", as that's the main mechanical limitation.

author: @CalixionArtz
text:
The main problem with GA is how much it warps the board state if it's not immediately answered, especially as a commander. Making all spells your opponents cast cost more while the ones you're casting cost less is extremely oppressive. Completely messes up tempo, and in a game where missing a single land drop can set you back a lot, having to find ANOTHER source of mana after this hits the field is very much in the "feels bad" section of cards.

Not to mention the colors it's in, which have some of the strongest control options in the game.

The Cubic Truth: Why Earth is Neither Flat Nor Round
For centuries, humanity has been locked in a false dichotomy, debating whether our planet is flat or spherical. Both camps have missed the obvious geometric truth staring us in the face: Earth is a cube. This revolutionary understanding reconciles countless anomalies that neither the flat-Earthers nor the round-Earthers can adequately explain, and it’s time we examined the compelling evidence for our planet’s true hexahedral nature.
First, consider the fundamental flaw in both traditional models. Flat-Earthers claim our world is a disk, yet they cannot explain how one travels from east to west continuously. Round-Earthers propose a sphere, but this fails to account for the distinctly angular nature of human experience. We don’t perceive gentle curves in our daily lives—we encounter corners, edges, and perpendicular intersections. Our cities are built on grids, our rooms have corners, and our maps are rectangular. Would we organize our world this way if Earth itself weren’t fundamentally cubic?
The cube model elegantly explains Earth’s six distinct climate zones, each corresponding to one face of the planetary cube. The top face, exposed directly to the sun, gives us the tropics. The bottom face, hidden in shadow, explains the frigid Antarctic region. The four side faces account for the temperate zones, with their varying exposures to sunlight creating the seasons as Earth rotates. This cubic arrangement clarifies why climate bands run in relatively straight lines across the globe—they’re following the edges where cube faces meet.
Navigation becomes remarkably straightforward under cubic Earth theory. When pilots claim to fly “around” the world, they’re actually tracing paths along the edges and faces of the cube. The apparent curvature they report is merely an optical illusion created by atmospheric refraction against the cube’s flat surfaces. Ships that “disappear over the horizon” are simply moving around the corner to an adjacent face of the cube. This explains why, despite sailing “straight,” vessels must constantly adjust their course—they’re navigating the angles between faces.
Consider too the evidence from space exploration. Why do space agencies show us images of a “round” Earth? Simple: they’re photographing the cube from an angle that creates circular perspective distortion. A cube, when viewed corner-on from sufficient distance, presents a hexagonal profile that can easily appear circular to the untrained eye. NASA’s reluctance to provide unobstructed corner-to-corner photographs of Earth isn’t censorship of the “round Earth lie” or the “flat Earth truth”—it’s suppression of the cubic reality.
The mathematics support this conclusion. A sphere’s surface area increases with the square of its radius, but actual planetary measurements suggest a relationship more consistent with cubic geometry. The Earth’s supposed “equatorial bulge” isn’t evidence of rotation-induced spherical deformation—it’s simply the natural geometry of a cube’s equator, which travels around all four vertical faces. When scientists calculate Earth’s volume and claim it matches a sphere, they’re using approximations that work equally well for a cube of similar dimensions.
Gravity itself makes more sense on a cubic Earth. Rather than pulling equally toward a central point as sphere-theory demands, cubic gravity pulls toward the center of whichever face you’re standing on. This explains why we feel no disorientation when traveling—we’re always experiencing gravity perpendicular to our local surface. The slight variations in gravitational strength measured at different locations? Those occur at the edges where two faces meet, creating the gravitational interference patterns that geophysicists have been misinterpreting for decades.
Even cultural and historical evidence supports the cubic model. Ancient civilizations built pyramids—partial cubes—as they attempted to mirror Earth’s true shape. The concept of “four corners of the Earth” appears repeatedly in historical texts, a clear reference to the four vertices visible from any position on the cube’s surface. Modern conspiracy theorists speak of “thinking outside the box,” which is itself a subconscious acknowledgment of our boxed-in planetary reality.
The technological implications are staggering. GPS systems don’t actually use satellites orbiting a sphere; they use a network of transmitters positioned at optimal points along the cube’s twelve edges. The “satellite” narrative is a convenient fiction to avoid explaining cubic orbital mechanics to a public not yet ready for the truth. Similarly, undersea cables don’t curve around a sphere—they run along the edges of the cube, following natural pathways that minimize distance and maximize signal strength.
Seasons, tides, and day-night cycles all become clearer under cubic analysis. As Earth rotates on its axis—which pierces through opposite corners of the cube—different faces receive varying amounts of sunlight. The moon’s gravitational pull affects the oceans differently depending on which faces they occupy, creating our tidal patterns. The apparent “curve” of Earth’s shadow on the moon during eclipses is actually the edge of one cubic face casting shadow on another celestial body.
Critics might ask why water doesn’t drain off the edges of a cubic Earth. The answer lies in advanced cubic hydrodynamics. Water naturally pools at the centers of each face, held by the specialized gravitational wells that form there. The oceans aren’t randomly distributed—they occupy specific faces and sections of faces according to principles of cubic geometry. What we call “sea level” is simply the equilibrium point on each face where gravitational forces balance perfectly.
In conclusion, the cubic Earth model represents a paradigm shift that unifies the observations of both flat and round Earth proponents while explaining phenomena neither can address. It’s time we opened our eyes to the angular truth of our existence and embraced the geometric reality that has been hiding in plain sight. The Earth is a cube—and once you understand this, everything else falls into place along perfectly perpendicular lines.

text:
How I make matcha as a blind person 🍵 do you have an easier way? Let me know 

Video description:
Lucy starts the video with two mugs, a wooden matcha whisk, milk and a packet of Naoki matcha. She starts by putting a teaspoon of matcha into one of the mugs, and pours a small amount of hot water into the mug (just enough to dissolve the matcha) - she then puts the matcha whisk to the side and pulls out a handheld blender. She then pours the milk into the second mug almost to the top. She puts that in her talking microwave. Once that’s out she pours the matcha mix into the milk and stirs.

author: @Lyd_2006
text: just wanted to offer an alternative in the comments. Obviously this is totally valid as an easier way of making the drink, especially if you're limited on time. For me, as a totally blind person myself, I would rather use a hob. And I'd use a normal kettle, hob and microwave. My induction hob has dials that click, so I know which numbers they're on, and the rings are marked with silicon things called pan-pickles. The microwave has things called bump-ons (rubber stickers) which I ask a sighted person to put over the buttons. For me, I prefer to use equipment that isn't specialised, but that has adaptions that I or the sighted people in my life can do quickly and cheaply. Not saying one way is better, but I find that sometimes people assume blind people can't use equipment unless it talks, so thought I'd clarify. :)

author: @do__ob
text:
Si, c'était réellement beaucoup trop cher pour la plupart des pièces.
C'est malheureux qu'ils doivent fermer, et je dirais pas que c'est bien fait pour eux, ça me fait pas plaisir des voire des magasins de JV (et qui plus est rétro) fermer. Mais j'y suis passé y'a moins de deux semaines et les prix de la plupart des objets sont absurdes. Il y a bien des exceptions, mais pas assez.
C'est pas que Full 7, je leur jette pas la pierre, les autres à côté sont pareils.
Seulement quand t'essayes de vendre une cartouche pokémon avec l'étiquette défoncée à 60 balles je peux pas juste dire "bon ok c'est un peu cher mais ça va". Non c'est beaucoup trop. Si c'était juste un peu plus cher mais raisonnable franchement j'irai au lieu d'éplucher LBV ou Vinted, et c'est dans cet esprit là que j'y suis retourné d'ailleurs. Mais c'est pas raisonnable du tout. Même easycash est moins cher, et pourtant c'est pas un modèle d'honnêteté.
C'est dommage de voir ces magasins fermer, et je suis désolé pour les propriétaires, les gérants et tous les employés. Malheureusement pour la plupart d'entre nous c'est pas acceptable d'acheter du rétro dans ces magasins.

author: @עידוכסלו
text: Just a few hours ago I disabled windowed apps after months of trying to make it work. I’ve had it. This is simply not intuitive to touch screens. Every time I try to access Notification Center now I either get this unnecessary menu bar or I resize the app. This is incredibly limiting, why all the borders of a full screen app are a resizing handle? I also can’t drag windows out anymore. I could waive an app out of the way previously, but now I need to tap the windows control button to have options, then try to tap minimize. This is not an expected behavior for a touch screen. I should not tap a button twice just to minimize or close an app. I need to be able to slide it, as Windows 8 mastered more than a decade ago. And of course, the keyboard has insane borders issue, even worse than on the iPhone, which is already a huge topic on social media on its own. Horrible update, who asked for this? It’s only redeeming quality is Liquid Glass

「自然な流れ」は非常に重要な音楽の要素の1つですね！またそれに対して我々が大まかに共通した良し悪しの感覚を持っているのもまた面白いです。

今回は「音高」に焦点を絞った解説でしたが、とても腑に落ちるものでした！！同じように「音長（音価）」にも「音高」と同じようにエネルギーの関係（高いとエネルギーが大きい、長いとエネルギーが大きい）があり、メロディはそれらを組み合わせでエネルギーの自然な流れを作るんだ！と考えているので、「もしかしたら、音長を用いれば今回の2つのルールを破ることは出来るかもしれない」と思いました！（研究してみます）

それにしても「センスセンス」と言われるメロディをここまで解説できるトイドラさんは素晴らしいです！！本日も動画ありがとうございました✨

text:
とても参考になりました。今まで、感覚頼みで行ってきたメロディーづくりを言語化するいいきっかけになりました。
素人考えで恐縮ですが(謙遜じゃなく本当に素人)、クローズボイスの３度ずつのアルペジオは準順次進行として、跳躍(４度以上)進行とは独立して考えていいのではないかなと個人的には思っています。私にとってメロディ作りは、順次進行、アルペジオ進行、跳躍進行、同音進行の４つをいかに組み合わせるかを考える思考過程だったと気付けました。
ありがとうございます。

author: @OtterloopB
text:
I feel like Code Vein II should've been on this list—or a future list.

A number of outlets described the game as "mediocre" but after having played and platinuming it... I can't agree. Code Vein II had great character customization. The exploration was rewarding with cool stuff tucked away in all sorts of nooks and crannies. The combat was solid. The characters were memorable. The storytelling was at times beautiful and emotional. The bosses were challenging. Nothing about Code Vein II felt "mediocre."

Yeah, the bike could use some adjustments. Some bosses definitely need rebalancing. And there are mechanics and terms that could use better explanation. But still, I thought it was a darn fine game. Much better than other Soulslike titles such as Steel Rising or The Surge.

text: I am 68 and I can say that other than learning the basics in the first 6 years of elementary school the rest was a complete waste of time. 7th, 8th and 9th grade was nothing more than repetition of what I already knew. Frustrated hearing the same old same old I quit school in the first quarter of 10th grade. Took the GED test, passed first time and had a High school degree while my class was still stuck in 10th grade. No computers back in the 1970's but we had books. If it was a subject I was Intrested in I sucked up information like a sponge. Back in school I struggled with memorizing what General fought in what battle yet I loved History. In short I have been self employed since 1989 and now at 68 I would not change a thing. If I had AI back in 1989 I would have been unstoppable as far as income earning goes. I still had to rely on books for knowledge and research.  Now research is measured in milliseconds. Other than the social aspect of school I have nothing good to say about it.  Starting College. Better make sure that dream job will be there for you in 4 years even if AI does not advance more than where we are at here today in 2026 and you know it's only going to get smarter and faster.  As far as schools go,for the most part they are finished in my opinion.

author: @Stepher45
text: Before I say this, I have to say art is the most subjective thing in the world and I can totally see why people find this game beautiful. With that said, I can’t stand the art style and it’s one of the biggest things keeping me from enjoying the game. The constant use of bright colors feels like an optic assault because there’s nothing to balance them out. I normally love bright colors but I feel like I’m being flashbanged every time I load into a round. Especially that one room type with the red lights, oh my goodness it genuinely hurts my eyes. However, all the shells do have incredible designs and look awesome. No issues with those.

text:
Como Sony ya había mandado al diablo a la consola en Occidente, los últimos juegos físicos en cartucho de PS Vita en 2021 salieron gracias a distribuidoras indie como Eastasiasoft o Limited Run que se aferraron a seguir imprimiendo en Asia y a venderlos por internet.

Fueron varios títulos muy de nicho que salieron a cuentagotas a finales de año, pero los principales que cerraron la historia fueron:

UnMetal: Una parodia de Metal Gear de un estudio español que es una joya total.

ScourgeBringer: Un roguelike bastante frenético.

Russian Subway Dogs y Ultra Mission.

Y el dato más enfermo es que el último cartucho físico que se despachó a nivel global fue un juego indie rarísimo llamado The Mooseman. Lo terminaron enviando ya casi entrando a 2022. Literalmente pura rareza para coleccionistas intensos.

text:
Άλλο ένα βίντεο που ξέρεις από τα πρώτα λεπτά θα πάει καλά! 

Στα του θέματος, μετάνιωσα στα τελευταία χρόνια ,την αγορά day one Tekken 7 και πιο αργά το Alan Wake Remastered για PS4. Τέλος ένα άλλο (κουλτούρα να φύγουμε) που απέτυχε να με αρέσει , ήταν το The Last Guardian, με τον αναθεματισμένο χειρισμό του και το πλάσμα αυτό τον Trico (κάπως έτσι νομίζω λέγεται) το οποίο έκανε πραγματικά ότι ήθελε και όποτε ήθελε. Κάποιοι μάλιστα φανατικοί , την δικαιολογούσαν αυτήν την δυσλειτουργία , με το άλλοθι ότι είναι ένα πλάσμα που δεν μπορεί να επικοινωνεί με το παιδί και σε αυτό οφείλεται ο κακός χειρισμός του... 

Στο 1ο ήταν αγορά επιπόλαια μιας και δεν παίζω τέτοια games , απλά ήθελα να έχω ένα fighting , το οποίο από το Tekken 3 είχα να παίξω ,  μου φάνηκε λιγότερο εντυπωσιακό βασικά από ότι το περίμενα , αλλά και αρκετά φτωχό για κάποιο λόγο... 

Η 2η αγορά ήταν το Alan Wake Remastered, που έπεσα στην φάκα γιατί είχα ακούσει τόσα για το story του και εν τέλει βρέθηκα να παλεύω με ψυγεία και μπουλντόζες, σε ένα σενάριο αλλόκοτο και ένα χειρισμό που με νευρίασε. Το αγόρασα μόλις κυκλοφόρησε full price, οπότε κάθισα και το έπαιξα ολόκληρο για να δικαιολογήσω την αγορά.

author: @Cheese-is-its-own-food-group
text: I’m 54 and I have auDHD and I’m also the sole caregiver to my 82 yr old mom. I struggle just to keep my own self afloat. I do have a younger brother who lives about 700 miles away. He’s always been exempt from having to do much of anything. He comes home for 3-4 days once or twice a year. He takes her out to eat and to shop and she enjoys it so much. I have tried to get her to join the senior center in our town but she is a diehard democrat and we live in a deep red community. She refuses to even try the senior center because she knows there’s likely a difference in politics. I have explained to her that all she has to do is refuse to discuss politics. She doesn’t have to say anything about her beliefs. They would never even know. She just wants me is what she always says. This is very difficult for me because I have different needs than a lot of folks. I sacrifice for her anyway because I love her. I take her to all of her doctors appointments, I take her out to eat, but I can’t do the shopping. Lighting in most stores makes me extremely anxious. There’s a strobe effect that I can see but everyone else claims they can’t. I don’t see how they miss it. My friends with autism know exactly what I mean. I’m dealing with challenges beyond the norm. I have called The Area on Aging and can’t get a call back. I’m thinking of doing what my husband suggested and get her a case manager through our local mental health provider. He would help me with my mom but he’s dealing with a dad with stage 4 liver cancer and his mom fell and broke her leg and needed surgery about a year ago and he has his hands full with them. It’s really tough. I take it day by day. I don’t think about tomorrow unless I need to plan something. I try to focus on what’s happening now. It keeps me from having multiple meltdowns every day. Meditation has been indispensable.

Imo what BSG is just sitting begging for is a First Cylon War era title far closer to that Sins mod. text:
I just tried Marathon with a friend for the Server Slam...We're also newcomers to not only this game but the extraction looter shooter...This game is overwhelming at first. I thought you could just go straight into team death match, not the case. Lots and lots of information slammed into your face. Everything is super confusing for a bit until you get a few runs under your belt. The classes and contracts and agencies are interesting...but again There's a lot to take in. 1 thing I had noticed in the runs, the NPC's are just as strong as the enemy team, you aren't master chief or a tank, you can die pretty easily.

On the plus side, it is really fun once you start understanding the game loop. The art style is super interesting imo. But I worry that there won't be enough content or that the first few hours will just overwhelm players and they will choose another game. Cuz at least with High Guard(After the mandatory Tutorial) you could at least jump right into it. The UI layout for Marathon is confusing as fuck too.

is it worth $40? hard to say. Maybe ill feel different after I put in more time today. I like it but there is a learning curve.

author: @semfoco100
text:
Pela minha pesquisa, a definição de gank nos games varia demais.

Em um momento, li que era obrigatório estar em vantagem numérica para, de fato, um ataque surpresa ser considerado um gank (o que corrobora com a teoria sobre a origem da palavra). Em outro momento, li que vantagem numérica não era um requisito, apenas o fator surpresa (o que corrobora com a ideia de que: gank, no contexto de lives, ganhou esse nome porque, quando você entrega sua audiência para um criador do nada, você causa um efeito surpresa. Ou seja, o efeito surpresa é o que define gank).

Sobre Albion, eu também li duas versões. Uma afirmava que gankar era o ato de eliminar um jogador para obter o loot, e o cara que focava em kills de maneira surpresa era o player killer. Já a outra afirmava que gankar era a kill em si, enquanto que pegar o loot era algo não relacionado com o termo.

Infelizmente, eu não entendo nada desses jogos para saber se gankar tem significado A ou B. Eu procurei no Google, no Reddit, nas IAs, em grupo de Whats (inclusive, eu causei uma mini guerra entre os loleiros quando perguntei sobre gank para eles kkkkkk), enfim, e cada momento eu encontrava uma resposta diferente.

Então, façam o favor de guerrearem aí nos comentários (respeitando o coleguinha) sobre o que é gank, porque isso dá engajamento e o ADM fica feliz 👍

Muito obrigado pela atenção.

author: @kimsnader8777
text:
I love playing with light.  I start by using natural light sources to determine my room's layout, then add in the ambient and task lights. The accent and decorative lights are where I have the most fun. My favorites these days are spotlights with goboes (a patterned stencil on the light source that creates interesting shadows) on a plant-filled corner to create a sense of movement and forest shadows, and small, low-wattage stained glass table lamps to serve as a way-finding light in a darkened room or hallway. The patterned shadows and dappled color washes add depth and texture in the evening hours.

You may want to expand your light curriculum to include the versatility that certain technical components offer:  dimmer switches, "smart" fixtures, motion and dawn-to-dusk sensing fixtures. And if you're into landscape lighting, the world opens to include solar fixtures. I've been having a lot of fun in this category, as well, experimenting with renter-friendly ways to light a deck and shadowy exterior walkways/staircases instead of relying on harsh, high-powered floodlights.

Regarding human circadian rhythm when it gets fully dark outside it is much better to minimise blue spectrum light inside our homes.

You can only do that effectively by using either old style very warm temperature Incandescent bulbs. Or by using specialist zero blue spectrum 1800K temperature LED bulbs.

You can take it even further if you have one of the latest high end smartphones that have a eye comfort night mode zero blue spectrum filter.

author: @dagttv
text: That last game was a WILD take of the story of Jonah and the Whale. The story of Jonah in the Old Testament is a tale of disobedience and mercy. God commands the prophet Jonah to warn the wicked city of Nineveh (location at the end), but he flees toward Tarshish (target the player wants to reach) to avoid doing so. After being swallowed by a massive fish (inside the "iron lung"), Jonah repents, travels to Nineveh (final scene), and his message causes the city to repent.  What's really interesting to me is that the Old Testament has this place called "Sheol".  Sheol is described as both the inside of the giant whale AND the very depths of hell itself.  It's a place that Jonah is sent as punishment for disobedience.  Being in a dark metal iron lung with no windows, no communication, mundane tasks is sort of the modern incarnation of Sheol--the last place a modern person would want to end up in.

So i wrote here the pattern if someone preffers it written all at one❤Crochet marshmallow keychain❤

The body of marshmallow
R1: 7sc in mr [7]
R2: 7inc [14]
R3: (sc, inc)×7 [21]
R4: (sc, inc, sc)×7 [28]
R5: BLO sc around [28]
R6-11: sc around [28]
R12: BLO (sc, dec, sc)×7 [21]

Put safety eyes between R7-8, 3stiches apart from each other

Stuff your marshmallow firmly

R13: (sc, dec)×7 [14]
R14: dec around [7]

 Fasten off and sew the hole closed

Legs
R1: 6sc in mr, slst 
         *make 2*

Sew the legs on round 11, 3 stiches apart

Embroider the mouth onto round 8

U can put on some blush for extra cuteness and ur done!!<33

author: @jakelm4256
text:
Unfortunately this is all mostly wrong. You failed to provide a completely definition, and the part you did (the goal) is just incorrect. 

Here is the definition, just to get it out of the way:

The study of the seven classical liberal arts ordered toward higher philosophy and ultimately theology, with a mastery of the canonical texts used in this classical period. 

The goal is not “the development of the whole student.” That could be argued as a property of classical education, but it’s not the end. 

Latin is also not necessary. Classical education is by definition historical. This real education was primarily divided into the Greek east (in Byzantium) and the Latin west. Unlike the west, the east had consistent access to the source texts which came out of Greece and studied them in the original language. Their grammatical and rhetorical arts were richer and more substantive than those in the west too. A student can very much  acquire a true classical education following the pipeline of the Latin west, but the point is the Greek east pipeline does not study Latin and it is at least as much a classical education.  

The “truth, goodness, and beauty” stuff throughout the video is just silliness. It’s a modern slogan that has nothing to do with classical education except in some contrived way. The cliche needs to go. Same with this whole emphasis on the ‘Great Book.’ It’s ahistorical and has no part in the education.

text:
Homemade Apple Pie Steps:

Ingredients
Crust: 2 (9-inch) pie crusts (homemade or store-bought)
Apples: 6–8 cups (peeled, cored, and 1/4-inch sliced) – Granny Smith, Honeycrisp, or a mix are recommended
Sugar: 1/2 cup granulated sugar and 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar
Thickener: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour or cornstarch
Spices & Flavor: 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp nutmeg, 1 tbsp lemon juice
Fat: 2 tbsp unsalted butter, cubed (for dotting)
Finish: 1 large egg + 1 tbsp milk (for egg wash), coarse sugar (optional) 
Step-by-Step Instructions
1. Prepare the Crust
If making homemade, combine flour, salt, and chilled butter, then add ice-cold water until the dough just holds together.
Divide into two disks, wrap in plastic, and chill for at least 1 hour.
On a floured surface, roll out one disk to a 12-inch circle and place it in a 9-inch pie plate. 
2. Prepare the Filling
Peel, core, and slice apples to 1/4-inch thickness.
In a large bowl, toss apple slices with lemon juice, sugars, flour (or cornstarch), cinnamon, and nutmeg until well coated.
Tip: Let the mixture sit for 20 minutes to allow the spices to penetrate. 
3. Assemble the Pie
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) or 425°F (220°C) depending on your recipe.
Spoon the apple filling into the bottom crust, mounding slightly in the center.
Dot the top of the apples with small pieces of butter.
Roll out the second disk of dough and place it on top of the filling.
Trim excess dough, seal the edges by pinching or fluting, and cut 4–5 slits in the top for steam ventilation.
Brush the top crust with egg wash and sprinkle with sugar. 
4. Bake the Pie
Place the pie on a rimmed baking sheet (to catch leaks) on the lower-middle rack.
Bake at 400°F–425°F for 15-25 minutes, then reduce oven temp to 350°F–375°F for another 40-50 minutes.
Tip: Cover the edges with a pie shield or foil if they brown too quickly.
The pie is done when the crust is deep golden brown and the filling is bubbling through the vents. 
5. Cool and Serve
Place the pie on a wire rack and let it cool for at least 3 hours. Note: Cutting into a warm pie will result in runny filling´´´´´´

author: @victorialg1270
text:
I've never had an issue with my small size soil blocks.
Only squash, cukes and melons get a larger size soil block.
I always sift before using.  I use a very moist soil and a spatula to make sure the material is well packed into the maker. 
Each year I get better at timing so I go straight to the garden and skip potting up to a pot.
Always double check if my seed does (or does not) want heat mat or light. Never let my cat walk across the seeds😂 and water slowly on the side, draining off anything left in the tray after 5 minutes.

In that sense, it’s just the rich getting richer. The actors need to be able to catch up to those rich people as well, just like the lower class needs to be able to catch up to the middle class. It’s the same thing — just a different bracket.

There’s no reason why The Parkers is making ad executives and company managers millions of dollars today — today and yesterday — and Mo’Nique isn’t making one cent from that show because she didn’t know how to negotiate her contract properly at the time.

Honestly, I think actors need to be able to go to court and sue for back residuals, or at least secure residuals moving forward, because this just isn’t right. text:
Here's one tax tip I push that I am constantly amazed there are no internet financial guru's pounding the table advocating the same...
If a couple each have a traditional IRA of their own, name your children/heirs as beneficiaries of some or all of the account.  My wife and I set up ours this way.  When she unexpectedly died at 70 our two sons received 80% of her Traditional and Roth IRA's.  They have 10 years to manage the distributions from their inherited IRA, $400k+ each.  If I survive at least 10 more years they will have another separate 10 year period to manage distributions from the IRA's they will inherit from me.  As the survivor, I have more time to continue making Roth conversions to lessen their eventual tax burden later.

Travelling solo sucks (unless you use a group like via Gadventures or something, and then hope you get lucky with a good group instead of solo weirdos).  Eating solo sucks.  Cinema alone sucks. author: @letrasconheart3681
text:
Juice Newton nació el 18 de febrero de 1952, es una influyente cantante y guitarrista estadounidense de pop y country, reconocida por su éxito comercial durante la década de 1980.

Actualmente, Newton se encuentra retirada de las giras (desde aproximadamente 2021) y reside en el área de San Diego, donde se dedica a su otra pasión: la cría y el comercio de caballos europeos. 

Newton alcanzó la fama mundial gracias a su estilo único que fusionó elementos del rock, pop y country. 

Sus canciones más emblemáticas incluyen "Angel of the Morning", "Queen of Hearts" y "The Sweetest Thing (I've Ever Known)".

Ganó un Grammy en 1983 a la Mejor Interpretación Vocal Country Femenina por "Break It to Me Gently" y recibió cinco nominaciones en totadue lo largo de su carrera. También fue galardonada con un premio ACM como Mejor Artista Femenina Revelación.

El video de "Angel of the Morning" fue el primer video de música country emitido en MTV.

A pesar de su retiro, su música ha experimentado un resurgimiento gracias a su inclusión en bandas sonoras de películas y series contemporáneas:

Deadpool (2016): Su versión de "Angel of the Morning" suena durante los créditos iniciales, lo que llevó a la canción a reingresar en las listas de Billboard y Spotify.

Promising Young Woman (2020): La misma canción se utiliza en una escena climática de más de cuatro minutos.

Yellowjackets (2025): Su éxito "Queen of Hearts" fue incluido recientemente en la serie de TV.

Razor's innate movespeed bonus is weird, but that means his powerspike item is also weird. It's Boots of Travel that makes him runs at 534 ms. Razor suffers from Silver Edge because of the movespeed cap, not the break for Forked Lightning passive.

author: @defaulted9485
text:
As a Razor main, I avoid picking Razor against Eye of Skadi and Linken core heroes and Outworld Devourer.

My favourite hero to bully with Razor is Sniper and melee heroes that isnt Bloodseeker. I hate Brewmaster, Meepo, Visage, and Juggernaut because his cast point for Omnislash is shorter than Razor's Static Link. I hate laning against Venomancer and Silencer because DoTs and Plague Ward doesnt get damaged by Plasma Field and Forked Lightning.

Razor will always be that weird hero which depending on his first item, whether its Aghs, Shard, Mekansm, Orchid, Yasha or BKB can still screw you over.

Therefore counter Razor's items first because Razor is the weakest at level 13-16 as I often polarize his build to the point it makes or break games.

Always hit Razor when his ult is down and make sure he doesnt buy shard or Silver Edge to hard counter anyone without force staff.

author: @Brandon_Powell
text:
I really loved how this game took place in the Arklay Mountains and its surrounding areas. I liked how they revealed that there was another city nearby that was basically another Raccoon City. I love how timeless Wrenwood feels with the fashion of the people, it still having pay phones, and many of the cars you see are old models.

1:41:14 However, I didn't love how the game pretends Leon doesn't exist because the camera isn't pointed at him. When he is in frame again, you hear him shout "Hey!" and go for his gun, but he's too late to do anything to stop her from being killed. 

But he still had plenty of time to act before that. I don't know why the scene insisted on lingering on the zombie for so long. Her death should have been a sudden thing that was completely unavoidable. The game pretends that's the case, but it isn't.

Maybe have some zombies start rustling around in the corridor, so Leon leaves the nurse in the examination room to deal with it. Only to rush in after hearing her screaming only to see her getting killed the moment you open the door.

text:
What a load of misinformation. First, walking away and back is not how you "trigger" the event (it can't be triggered, it's just random).
Second, you don't have to kill the sheriff, just wait until the scene ends and the sheriff starts walking away. Simply push him, he will pull out his revolver, beat it out of his hand, he will pull out repeater, disarm him the same way, he will finally pull out his bolt action rifle. Beat if out of his hands and immediately pick it up from the ground. Then immediately go to the main menu, open compendium and verify that the rifle has been added to your weapons, then go to Settings->Graphics and run the benchmark test. When it loads, just stop the test, you will return back to the game. You will respawn in Valentine with your new rifle saved to your inventory with no bounty on your head and no honor penalty.

author: @MateusAsato
text:
My songs might not have lyrics, but they have stories - and if you don't mind me sharing this "last one" with you, I'd love to do that!

The initial draft of this song [back in 2017] used to be called 'Chords', and some people would remember that. But after things got more serious and I finally finished writing this piece, I felt this song needed another name. 

'Kawaii' was probably one of the most memorable words my brain kept after my first trip to Japan 9 years ago. It is an easy word to absorb sonically. And another thing I noticed around that trip was - Kawaii was a word often to be associated with kids and babies. I just remember hearing people saying 'kawaii' and laughing or showing their biggest and most genuine smile after speaking that word - and that moved me in a special way. 

This song is probably the most simple of the album - one guitar track, quiet bass, small drums and an electric piano. Almost a lo-fi type of song, with the effect of "less is more" activated - which is so rare for a guitar player, including myself. 
I remember while recording the demo and the final version at East West - I wanted it to feel the "purity" of this music, even though I still can't explain what that means exactly.

The idea of Kawaii's Music Video was the easiest to visualize comparing the other ones we did. It was clear enough to me that there was no better message than having kids as the main characters to carry the message of it.

This song is a reminder to the innocence - a call to genuine joy, and the search for a pure life's perspective. 
The shortcut to God's happiness.

Thank you for watching! 

Ps.: "ASATO' is around the corner! Can't believe!!!

Kindest regards,
MA.

text: Ever since Dave Grohl re-introduced the world to this song and then people discovered that the video for Lady Madona is actually a video for this song,  there's been a lot of controversy about where this song stands in the Beatles catalog. So much so that it made #1 in a big inernational poll once, sandbagged no doubt by enthusiasts of Grohl. It was written in a day because Lennon thought it was ridiculous to sit around in the studio doing nothing while they shot the Lady Madonna video. For me I like it. It's catchy and though the lyrics are a bit sketchy, the musicc and arrangents are unique and I could listen all day to Lennon sing "if you're lonly you can talk to me". Overall to me it stands as a testament of how hard it was for the Beatles to write a bad song. Even fun little exercises like this are really good.

Young man, if you actually wanted to diagnose the intellectual decay of our education system, you brought on the exact wrong person. Inviting a competitive exam tutor to fix education is precisely why the system remains an intellectual wasteland. Abhinay Maths does not teach the unyielding, axiomatic discipline of pure mathematics; he teaches cheap algorithmic shortcuts and rote-memorization tricks so desperate students can pass multiple-choice exams for government desk jobs. He is a symptom of the exact transactional 'brain rot' you claim to be fighting.

If you wanted to discuss how to forge actual, world-class intellects, you should have called a foundational logician or a strict pure mathematician someone like Dr. Paolo Aluffi, or a Fields Medalist like Manjul Bhargava. You sit there complaining that schools don't teach trivial vocational skills like the 'stock market' or 'management.' That is absolute nonsense. If you subjected a student's mind to uncompromising, hardcore mathematical logic, they could teach themselves the rules of the stock market in a weekend. Instead, you are watering down the definition of education to mean 'corporate job training.' Stop validating this mediocrity and start demanding actual academic discipline.

text:
When I was a kid my mother would take us to the local diner on Fridays for dinner, and they had those table side juke boxes.  She would give my sister and I quarters to play songs.  

This song must have just come out as I was obsessed with this tune, and I would play it so many times in a row.  I remember saying to my mother that I’d love to meet Ringo Starr not realizing at the time who he was or who he used to play with. 

I was about 9 or 10 when this song came out, and I remember asking for a kazoo for my birthday that year.  

I want to say to you that your content is awesome my man, and I am really enjoying the videos you’re putting out.

author: @letrasconheart3681
text:
John Francis Bongiovi Jr., mejor conocido como Jon Bon Jovi nació el 2 de marzo de 1962 en Nueva Jersey, es un icónico cantante, compositor y actor estadounidense, mundialmente reconocido como el fundador y líder de la banda de rock Bon Jovi, formada en 1983. Con éxitos masivos como "Livin' on a Prayer" y "Always", ha vendido millones de discos, ha sido incluido en el Salón de la Fama del Rock and Roll (2018) y es un reconocido filántropo.

Comenzó tocando en bandas locales en Nueva Jersey antes de triunfar con su éxito de 1980, "Runaway". Su banda alcanzó el estrellato mundial en la década de los 80 con álbumes como Slippery When Wet (1986) y New Jersey (1988).

Ha lanzado álbumes en solitario como Blaze of Glory (1990) y ha actuado en películas como U-571 y series como Ally McBeal.

Está casado con Dorothea Hurley desde 1989, a quien conoció en la escuela secundaria, y tienen cuatro hijos.

Fundó la Jon Bon Jovi Soul Foundation en 2006 para combatir la pobreza y la falta de vivienda, siendo nombrado Persona del Año por MusiCares en 2024.

Ha vendido más de 130 millones de discos en todo el mundo.

Es miembro del Songwriters Hall of Fame y del Rock & Roll Hall of Fame (clase de 2018).

Considerado el "rostro" del hair metal de los 80 que logró transicionar con éxito al rock de estadios y al country-rock en décadas posteriores. 

Jon ha pasado los últimos tres años en terapia intensiva para rehabilitar su voz. Aunque admite que el proceso ha sido un "viaje de montaña rusa", se siente listo físicamente para los shows de este verano.

En entrevistas recientes por su cumpleaños, confesó estar "bien con el envejecimiento", luciendo sus canas con orgullo y celebrando su nuevo rol como abuelo por partida doble tras el nacimiento de sus nietas en 2025.

Happy birthday Jon Bon Jovi! 🥳💘💘💘💘

시원님저 아직 여기 있어요.
이제는 그냥 자연스럽게, 습관처럼 오게 되네요. 영상이 올라오면 반가워서 오고, 안 올라와도 괜히 한 번 들어와 보게 되고요. 사실 이런 어두운 얘기는 안 하고 싶었어요. 댓글에서는 항상 밝게, 장난스럽게, 주접 떠는 사람으로 남고 싶었거든요.웃기게 굴고, 괜히 유죄라 하고, 책임지라고 장난치는 그 모습이 저인 것 같아서요. 시원님께 앞만 보고 걷겠다고, 지금의 내가 할수있는 최선을 다 하겠다고 했는데 약속 못지켜서 미안해요. 근데 오늘은 조금 솔직해지고 싶었어요. 저는 항상 밝은 모습으로 오는 건 아니에요. 슬프게도 그런날이 오늘인것 같아요. 설명할수 없을 정도로 무기력하고, 이유 없이 우울해질 때도 많고, 요즘은 특히 인간관계 때문에 몇 달째 계속 아파하고 있어요. 행복한 날보다 상처받는 날이 더 많고, 괜히 혼자 조용히 무너지는 때도 많아요. 울다가도 남들은 이런 과정 다 거치고, 주위만 둘러봐도 힘들어하는 사람이 천지에 널렸는데. 나는 이런거 하나때문에, 이유없이 우울한 날도 있는데. 나만 너무 호들갑 떠는구나. 스스로 "아파할 시간없어. 이제 정신 좀 차려." 라고 세뇌시키면 슬픔이라는 대재항이 쓸고 남은 폐허가 된 내 마음에 공허함만이 조용히 내려앉아요. 정말로 힘들땐 불안하고 우울해서 온몸이 사시나무 떨듯 떨리고, 숨은 물속에서 작은 빨대로 숨쉬는것 같고, 머리는 깨질것 같이 아프고 겉으로는 아무렇지 않은 척 웃고 있어도 속에서는 계속 생각이 맴돌고, “내가 문제지.” 싶어 더 작아지는 날도 있어요. 왜 아무도 없는 귀한 기회가 생길때는 눈물이 안나는걸까요. 왜 "여기서 무너지면 안돼" 라고 외칠때는 눈물이 미친듯이 흐르는걸까요. 화장실로 도망치듯 들어와서 거울을 보면 낯선 이가 서있어요. 눈은 짙은 체념과 슬픔, 절망이 가득하고, 얼굴은 피폐해요. 또 눈에는 뜨거운 무언가가 흐르고 있어요. 그게 눈물인지 다른 감정인지는 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 거울보면서 울고 있는 눈을 감추려고 억지로 웃어보인적 있으세요? 눈에서 눈물은 계속 흐르고, 억지로 미소를 지으니까 입꼬리는 경련이 날것 같고. 그모습을 조용히 지켜보는 나 자신은 오늘도 그렇게 무너져내립니다. 그모습이 참 기괴하거든요. 아이유님 아이와 나의 바다라는 노래가사에 "거울속에 마주친 얼굴이 어색해서, 습관처럼 조용히 눈을 감아." 다른사람은 노래 좋다 하고 넘어갔을텐데. 나는 왜그렇게 그 말이 아프게 들렸을까. 내 마음을 대변해주는 것 같아 가슴에 더 와닿았던것 같아요. 조용히 그 가사를 읇조리며 하루종일 생각했어요. "어디서 부터 잘못된걸까." 그래서 댓글에서는 더 밝게 굴었던 것 같아요. 원래 그런 사람이라기보다는, 그렇게 있고 싶어서요. 근데 거짓말이 아니라 정말 힘든 날이 오면 저는 시원님 노래를 들어요. 누가 시킨 것도 아닌데 검색창에 이름을 치고, 익숙한 영상 다시 누르고, 기타 소리 깔리고 시원님의 잔잔한 저음 목소리가 들리면 그제야 조금 숨이 쉬어져요. 완전히 괜찮아지는 건 아니에요. 하루가 갑자기 밝아지는 것도 아니고, 제가 갑자기 단단해지는 것도 아니에요. 근데 “그래도 오늘 여기까지는 버텨보자. 내일까지는 버텨보자." 라는 생각은 들어요. 그 정도면 저한테는 꽤 큰 구원이에요. 그리고 제가 남긴 별거 아닌 댓글에도 항상 진심으로, 시간을 들여서 정성스럽게 답글 달아주셔서 너무 감사해요. 시원님 답글 읽다가 운 적도 정말 많아요. 그냥 몇 줄일 뿐인데 그날 하루를 붙잡아주는 느낌이었어요. "아, 내가 완전히 혼자인 건 아니구나" 그렇게 느끼게 해줬어요. 정말 거짓말이 아니라 힘든 날이 오면 저는 여기로 오게 돼요. 행복한 날보다 상처받는 날이 더 많은 사람이라도 완전히 무너지지 않게 지탱해주는 공간이 있다는 게 저한테는 큰 의미예요. 이 목소리는 저를 완전히 구해주는 영웅 같은 건 아니지만 어둡던 방 안에 작은 스탠드 하나 켜주는 빛 같아요. 그래서 저는 계속 올 것 같아요. 밝은 날에도, 힘든 날에도, 괜히 이유 없이 가라앉는 날에도요. 어두운 얘기는 잘 안 하려고 했는데 그래도 이 말은 꼭 남기고 싶었어요. 고마워요. 노래 오래 해주세요. 저는 오래 듣고 싶어요. '김시원' 이라는 사람 자체를 좋아하고 의지하며 살아온게 행동 자체가 정말 큰 힘이 된것같아요. 시원님 영상을 그냥 보기만 한게 아니에요. 음악적 시각을 넓혔고, 많은 생각을 하는 방법을 배웠고, 똑바로 걷는 법을 배웠고, 위로받는 법을 배웠고, 누군가를 올바르게 의지하는 법도 배웠어요. 나이를 먹을수록 아파하고, 현실적인 부분이 많아지며 어렸을땐 이해하지 못했던 어른들의 행동이 하나둘씩 이해하게 되더라구요. 평생 몰랐으면 좋겠지만 그게 현실 아니겠어요? 모든게 하나하나 다 지쳐버려서 내려놓고 싶을때도 많지만 진짜로 의지할 곳이 없어서 그런지 어느순간 부터 시원님을 찾게 되더라고요. 죽을것 같아도 떨리는 손으로 시원님을 찾아 노래를 들어요. 그럼 정말 거짓말처럼 좀 머릿속이 정리되거든요. 제가 항상 헛소리만 하는거 같아도 전 모든 댓글을 최소 3~5시간 고민한후 적어요. 많게는 하루종일 걸리기도 하고요. 답글을 보면 항상 시원님은 정말 성숙하신것 같아요. 저랑 나이차이가 그렇게 많이 나지않으시는것 같은데 시원님 앞에 서면 저는 걸음마를 때지도 못한 아이가 되는것 같아요. 그럴수록 시원님은 따뜻하게 제 손을 잡고 걸을수 있게 도와주시고요. 정말 감사해요. 항상 이렇게 어두운 부분을 꺼내놓으면 다른사람들은 제 상처에 소금을 뿌리고 침을 뱉는데 시원님은 따뜻하게 치료해주셔서 너무너무 감사해요. 부드럽지만, 단호하게. 따뜻하지만 현실적으로 좋은 조언만 해주셔서 너무 감사하고 존경스러워요. 항상 좋은 말씀 감사하고 오늘까지 해서 70일째 시원님을 좋아했네요. 앞으로 오래오래 자주자주 마니마니 봤으면 좋겠고, 변치않는, 더 큰 사랑으로 오빠 응원 할게요. 오늘도 좋지 않고, 긴 이야기 였지만 들어주셔서 너무너무 감사하고 답글 계속 안자구 기다릴꺼에요..사랑합니다...♥️😊

author: @manthony1956
text: Around Christmas 1979, I built one of every Airfix OO kit we had in the hobby shop I worked part-time for in Northern California. Although their specialty was (and still is) Lionel toy trains and their ilk, we served the model train hobbyist. Though just static models, the display turned out rather well, and helped sales. Just like cardstock buildings, which go back eighty? years, properly placed static models really add to the layout. It is one of the reasons I look through junk boxes at train meets. Some of that junk can turn out to be real diamonds in the rough. The additions look great. A model railroad is never finished, just done for now.

author: @raycrq
text:
Esto es una interpretación libre, pero creo que quiere darnos a entender esto:

Rosalía yace sobre la arena implacable del desierto. Su cuerpo no apareció allí por azar; fue desechada, arrojada al vacío por manos anónimas. Mientras el calor la consume y su rostro roza el suelo, los fragmentos de un amor terrenal la inundan.
Son recuerdos tangibles: una piel que pudo tocar, una mirada que fue real, un vínculo que, aunque físico, la dejó vulnerable y a la deriva. El silencio del desierto se quiebra con el rugido de un motor. Un Rolls-Royce se desliza por el horizonte como un espejismo de metal. Al
detenerse, de él desciende una figura cuya esencia desafía la lógica; no es un ser humano, es una presencia fuera de este mundo. Sin mediar palabra, este guía espiritual la levanta del polvo y la traslada a un refugio seguro, lejos del abandono.
En ese santuario, Rosalía experimenta una metamorfosis. 

Logra conectar finalmente con un amor espiritual, una fuerza superior que trasciende la carne y los recuerdos del pasado.
Comprende que, para nacer de nuevo, debe destruir el último rastro de su antigua vida.
Con una determinación absoluta, prende fuego al Rolls-Royce. Mientras las llamas devoran el símbolo del lujo y el ego, Rosalía no solo observa el incendio: utiliza el calor de esa destrucción para encender su propia luz interna, una llama que ya nada ni nadie podrá apagar.

author: @bruno_amor
text: My interpretation: Watching it, I felt like it visually deepens everything the lyrics suggest about detachment and transformation. The desert setting immediately struck me as a space of stripping away, no distractions, no luxury, just exposure. Seeing her lying on the ground, almost as if fallen or emptied out, contrasted so strongly with the sensual, glamorous scenes inside the car. That back-and-forth feels intentional: wealth and intimacy on one side, dust and vulnerability on the other. The lover is never shown, which to me makes it less about a specific person and more about presence… something unseen that lifts her but doesn’t overshadow her. And when the car burns, echoing the line about lighting her light with the Rolls-Royce she’ll set on fire, it feels like a chosen renunciation rather than a tragedy. By the end, when she stands calmly watching it burn, there’s no panic, only a sense of peace. It doesn’t feel like a breakup story; it feels like freedom arriving precisely when there’s nothing left to lose, when love becomes the only real capital. Also in the part she sings “tu amor será mi capital…” knowing she wrote this lyrics inspired in St Teresa de Àvila I cannot but hear something about how Teresa used to call her greatest lover: “Mi Capitán!” It is so close…. Looove this album so much!!! ❤

author: @brunorivvt
text:
Sauvignon Blanc habla de abandonar todo lo que tenemos para poder amar a alguien. Está inspirada en esa idea de dejarlo todo para seguir a Dios y entregarnos a Él, sin aferrarnos a lo material. Rosalía lo expresa de una forma más romántica, pero el trasfondo se siente más profundo, casi espiritual.
El video refuerza esto, hace alusión a Jesús en el desierto, salvando o guiando a otros. Ese “ser invisible” que conduce el auto y llega hasta donde Rosalía está inmóvil en el suelo y la levanta puede interpretarse como una presencia divina que la rescata.
La letra funciona como ese espejo de entrega total por amor, con frases como: “No tengo miedo del pasado… a tu lado mi futuro será dorado”, que transmiten confianza absoluta y fe.

MV 中隱藏的蛛絲馬跡、文學隱喻與吸血鬼典故分析：
一、 隱藏的名畫與藝術致敬
MV 幾乎每一幕都有藝術史的影子，場景設計與運鏡高度還原了名畫的構圖：
1. 惠斯勒的母親 (Whistler's Mother)：MV 開頭 [00:21] 處，那名坐在椅子上發出尖叫的老婦人，其裝束與側臉構圖完全致敬詹姆斯·惠斯勒的名作《灰與黑的改編第1號》。
2. 馬拉之死 (The Death of Marat)：[00:34] 浴缸中的男子倒下的場景，完美還原了雅克-路易·大衛描繪法國大革命領導者馬拉遇刺後的模樣，連桌上的信件細節都做了還原。
3. 杜爾博士的解剖學課 (The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp)：[01:01] 周杰倫混入一群戴著白色領圈的人群中觀察屍體，這幕構圖取自林布蘭的名畫。有趣的是，畫中原本是醫學解剖，MV 中則變成了檢查吸血鬼的咬痕 [01:13]。
4. 地獄裡的丹特與維吉爾 (Dante and Virgil)：[01:17] 畫面中出現兩人瘋狂扭打、啃咬頸部的場景，是威廉-阿道夫·布格羅描繪但丁《神曲》地獄篇的名作，這裡暗喻了吸血鬼原始的野性。
5. 蒙娜麗莎 (Mona Lisa)：[01:20] 達文西的名作出現，但畫像上出現了兩個吸血鬼的咬痕 [01:22]，甚至流下了血淚，將文藝復興的古典與暗黑美學結合。
6. 奧菲莉亞 (Ophelia)：[01:58] 漂浮在水草與花叢中的女子，致敬了約翰·艾佛雷特·米萊的拉斐爾前派代表作，這也對應了歌詞中提到的哈姆雷特意象。
7. 吻 (The Kiss)：[02:23] 金燦燦的背景與擁吻的男女，完全復刻了古斯塔夫·克林姆的風格。但在 MV 中，溫馨的擁吻隨即轉化為吸血鬼的咬頸 [02:24]，強調了「致命的愛」。
8. 夜鷹 (Nighthawks)：[03:05] 街角玻璃窗內的深夜食堂，是愛德華·霍普描繪都會孤寂的名作。
9. 梵谷系列：
• 割耳後的自畫像：[03:38] 綁著繃帶抽煙斗的男子正是梵谷。
• 奧維爾教堂 (The Church at Auvers)：[03:51] 周杰倫走進畫中傾斜、暗藍色的教堂建築。
• 夜間咖啡館 (The Night Café)：[03:19] 旋轉的燈光與扭曲的室內空間感。
• 記憶的永恆 (The Persistence of Memory)：[03:23] 背景中出現了達利式的「融化的時鐘」。
二、 歌詞裡的文學隱喻
方文山的歌詞為 MV 鋪墊了深厚的文學底蘊：
• 莎士比亞筆下的純真與哈姆雷特的花：[01:49] 這裡引申自《哈姆雷特》中奧菲莉亞在河邊採花、最終悲劇溺亡的文學典故。歌詞用「解不過去的真理」來對比名畫中凝固的瞬間。
• 救贖來臨前始終不語：[01:39] 帶有濃厚的宗教文學色彩，描述受難者在成為吸血鬼或死亡前的沈默與掙扎。
• 克林姆的吻是一種分離：[02:22] 將繪畫中的絕美瞬間詮釋為告別，隱喻了美好事物的脆弱。
三、 吸血鬼典故與意象
MV 雖然走華麗風格，但保留了許多古典吸血鬼的傳統設定：
• 與「太陽之子」的對立：吸血鬼在傳說中被稱為「Children of the Night (黑夜之子)」，歌名《太陽之子》象徵著周杰倫所扮演的獵人角色是光明、救贖的化身。
• 古典元素：
• 吸血鬼獵人裝束：周杰倫的長風衣、手套，以及使用的銀色子彈 [04:27] 和十字架 [06:10]，都是傳統驅魔題材的標配。
• 蝙蝠轉身：[04:54] 吸血鬼被擊中後化為無數蝙蝠散去，是典型的德古拉典故。
• 鏡子與酒吧：在「夜鷹」酒吧一幕，周杰倫透過鏡子與觀察來尋找偽裝成人類的吸血鬼 [03:12]，對應了吸血鬼在鏡中沒有倒影或倒影會現原形的傳說。
• 艾布辛 (Absinthe)：酒吧中出現的綠色酒液 [02:57]，被稱為「綠色妖精」，常出現在19世紀哥德文學中，象徵幻覺與靈感，常與吸血鬼那種頹廢、迷幻的氣質聯繫在一起。

author: @hiromarucook
text:
【材料】
おにぎり：1個（しっかり冷ましたもの）
海苔：1枚（全形なら半分にカット）
アルミホイル：海苔より一回り大きいサイズ1枚
マスキングテープ：20〜30cm（つまみを作るので長めに用意）
サラダ油：少々（くっつき防止用）

【作り方】
1.海苔をホイルで包む
アルミホイルを広げ、中央に海苔を置いて、ホイルを内側に折りたたみ海苔を完全に包みます。
　Point: 海苔がはみ出さないよう、ホイルは少し余裕を持ったサイズにしましょう。

2.「開け口」のテープを貼る
ホイルを裏返し（重なり目がない綺麗な面）、中央にマスキングテープを縦に1本貼ります。
　Tip: テープの下端を少し折り返して「つまみ」を作っておくと、開ける時にスムーズです。

3.おにぎりをセットする
再度ひっくり返し、中央におにぎりを置きます。

　重要: このとき、おにぎりが当たるホイル部分に薄く油を塗っておくと、食べる時にホイルがペリッと綺麗に剥がれます。

4.ふんわり包む
おにぎりをホイルで包みます。この時、きつく締めすぎず**「若干ゆるめ」**に包むのが、海苔を割らずに綺麗に仕上げるコツです。

5.完成・食べ方
食べるときは、中央のテープを引いてホイルを左右に引き抜くだけ！コンビニおにぎり同様のパリパリ感が楽しめます。

author: @rblongfellow
text:
Fantastic video. Door with the magnets is marvelous.

You might not need a relay. I use two temp switches like you have, I have one with the probe stuck into the fins plugged in the power and another temp switch with the actual room temp plugged into the fin switch. So when it gets to 32 it turns off power to the unit and you can set the differential on the switch to not allow the other switch to come on for 4 or 5 degrees. 

My ACs usually last 5 yrs but some brands are better than others. LG used to be good, i bought some during the supply shortage and those units were really bad. Im using Frigidaire at the moment in two coolers and finding them to be great but I only have two years on them so far. I use them on our farm for vegetable storage so quite a bit of moisture and humidity but they work well and have saved us a down payment on a large house. 

The other thing I'll add, for bigger coolers I have found it better to use two smaller units rather than one big one. The smaller ones are always cheaper, easier to maneuver, and build redundancy into the system so you're not sunk if one goes out. They're so cheap it allows you to buy an extra one to have on hand at the ready as well. 

Anyway, great job thanks for sharing.

author: @kelf114
text:
Three Dog Night was one of my first favorite bands! "My song" is Never Been to Spain. 
I liked Neil Diamond when I was growing up. My fav is Brother Love's Traveling Salvation Show. 
Glenn Campbell was suddenly everywhere! Every variety show, and parodied by comedians of the day. (My pick: Witchita Lineman.)
Stones: Can't beat Can't You Hear Me Knocking. 
CCR was my mom's favorite band. I know all their songs. I'm a little sick of their stuff (lol). 
Ooh, I loved Blood, Sweat, and Tears, too. My pick - And When I Die. 
One of my biggest Beatles memory (aside from the cartoon) was my dad loving Lady Madonna when it came out. 
Honestly, I never really cared for CSN. Guinnevere is a pretty song. If I had to pick one, I'd go with Cathedral. That song spoke to me. 
The song Get Together (Youngbloods) will always remind me of a dreamy spring day. 

Hope everything and everyone is doing well. Glad to see you again. Whatever time you may need, though, please take it. Keeping you and yours in my prayers. 😊♥️
